findings.why: The ASL entry APR-009 still shows approved with no end date. The later 8D records that the approval for HB-620 was revoked on 2026-09-15, which is before today (2026-11-14). The meeting date of 2026-09-01 predates the revocation, but the revocation is in force now. SUP-D therefore has no current approval for HB-620 for Nordhavn, and the ASL record appears outdated.
